notes: v1.1.111: Fixes the no-cookie Arkose login. 1.1.110 bundled the wrong (headless) browser, which Facebook detects, so the Arkose puzzle never appeared and those logins failed. 1.1.111 bundles the full browser, which is shown the puzzle and lets the solver work; the old headless browser is removed on start. Arkose is a fallback: easy puzzles are usually solved, very hard ones can still fail. Accounts that have a cookie skip Arkose altogether (password + 2FA, no browser, about 15 s). Also carries 1.1.110 (Login path carries the account's device cookies, plain-word login progress in Status Detail, Warm Up picker Status filter + right-click menu), 1.1.109 (browser-less MetaMax-style relogin), 1.1.108, 1.1.107 and 1.1.106.
